notes.title: New Version Out! Patch Notes – v1.0.0.0 (2025)
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a new major update! With the launch of Ukko & Guará: Stellarbound on consoles, we’ve made several improvements across all platforms. To reflect these enhancements, the game version has been updated to v1.0.0.0 (2025).

Here’s what’s new:

Added a Best Time Leaderboard to track your fastest playthroughs of the main game

Introduced a Three-Star Scoring System to reward level perfection

Numerous visual and effects enhancements for a more immersive experience

Improved gamepad support and responsiveness

Game design refinements for better flow and challenge balance

General bug fixes and stability improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.2.1)
notes.notes:
- Improvements to the game experience: animations, effects, user interface, and controls
- Implementation of the options menu in the pause menu
- Some game interface and gameplay fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.2)
notes.notes:
Various improvements, fixes, and adjustments have been made in version 1.2. See below:


     Implemented compatibility with Switch Pro controller
     3 new languages added: Russian, French, and Korean
     Fixed minor issues and general adjustments
     Minor visual improvements and adjustments
     Save game algorithm improvements
     Improvement: smoother aiming with the gamepad
     Improvement: button to facilitate gameplay for young children
     Improvement: scroll down the level selection screen when navigating with controls
     Improvement: added character health bar tutorial
     Improvement: confirmation of progress loss when starting a new game

notes.title: (Patch Notes v1.1) Game controllers compatibility improvements
notes.notes:
We have worked on improvements for game controllers compatibility, mainly Xbox and PlayStation controllers. The game now correctly displays button labels based on the current game controller in use.

Patch Notes v1.1
- Added compatibility to PlayStation controllers (DualShock 4 and DualSense)
- Improved compatibility with Xbox controllers
- Added button labels to the UI for game controllers
- Game tutorials improvements
- Minor bug fixes and improvements
